from shipcalc import pricing, pallets, weighbridge, tare, surcharges, labels, calc, rates, reports, storage
from shipcalc.models import Item, Order
from shipcalc.units import WeightError
from shipcalc.limits import check_total_kg
from shipcalc import export, plugins, auditlog, importer, cache, demo, validate, format as F
def chk(name, got, want):
    print('OK ' if got == want else 'BAD', name, repr(got), '' if got==want else 'want '+repr(want))
# freight
for w,r,want in [('0.125',100,12),('0.375',100,38),('0.003',500,2),('0.001',499,0),('2.000',350,700),('1.0005',100,100),('1.0015',100,100)]:
    chk('freight '+w, pricing.freight_cents(w,r), want)
# pallets
for t,n,p in [('250.000',1,50),('1.250',1,0),('2.500',1,0),('7.500',1,2),('12.500',1,2),('500.000',1,100),('500.001',2,50)]:
    o=Order([Item('A',t)]); chk('pallets '+t, (pallets.pallet_count(o), pallets.fill_percent(o)), (n,p))
# weighbridge
for d,m,a,w in [('1.000','1.020','0.020',True),('1.000','1.021','0.020',False),('10.025','10.225','0.200',True),('10.025','10.226','0.200',False),('10.075','9.873','0.202',True),('0.500','0.480','0.020',True)]:
    chk('allow '+d, weighbridge.allowance_kg(d), a); chk('within '+d+' '+m, weighbridge.within_tolerance(d,m), w)
# tare
for g,p,t,n,na in [('10.005',10,'1.000','9.005',0),('10.015',10,'1.002','9.013',0),('0.005',50,'0.002','0.003',0),('0.015',50,'0.008','0.007',0),('3.000',0,'0.000','3.000',0)]:
    chk('tare '+g, (tare.tare_for_percent_kg(g,p), tare.net_after_percent_kg(g,p)), (t,n))
# labels
chk('lift 25.000', labels.lift_notice(Item('A','25.000')), '')
chk('lift 25.001', labels.lift_notice(Item('A','25.001')), '2-PERSON LIFT')
chk('label', labels.label(Item('MUG-01','0.350',2)), 'MUG-01 0.350 kg x2')
chk('label2', labels.label(Item('CRATE','25.001')), 'CRATE 25.001 kg x1 2-PERSON LIFT')
# surcharges
t=surcharges.load()
for w,c in [('1.000',0),('1.001',150),('15.000',400),('15.001',900)]:
    chk('surch '+w, surcharges.cents_for(w,t), c)
# plugins example
ps=plugins.load(); o=Order([Item('F1','0.300',3),Item('H','4.000')])
chk('fragile', ps[0].surcharge_cents(o), 360); chk('bulky', ps[1].surcharge_cents(o), 0); chk('ins', ps[2].surcharge_cents(o), 90)
chk('total', calc.order_weight_kg(o), '4.900')
# rates / reports
chk('avg', reports.average_weight_kg(Order()), '0.000')
chk('avg2', reports.average_weight_kg(Order([Item('A','1.000'),Item('B','2.000',2)])), '1.667')
# limits
chk('limit ok', check_total_kg('2147483.647'), '2147483.647')
try: check_total_kg('2147483.648'); print('BAD no limit error')
except WeightError as e: print('OK  limit error', e)
# storage / demo
for n in demo.names(): print('demo', n, [ (i.sku,i.weight_kg,i.qty) for i in demo.load_demo(n).items])
print('sample', [ (i.sku,i.weight_kg,i.qty) for i in storage.load('samples/order.json').items])
print('gen', open('shipcalc/data/surcharges.json').read()==__import__('shipcalc.gen_surcharges',fromlist=['x']).render())
"
